thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] P2 - elevated 5xx rate + p95 latency detected in eu-central-1 for Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Trigger: api.5xx_rate > 8% & p95 latency > 600ms (5m). Paging @pager-oncall. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd1234

alice: I'm on the pager. Confirming spikes across hosted routes and ~2 dedicated pools (ded-eu-c-1, ded-eu-c-2). Seeing lots of upstream 502/504s in logs, looks like auth/token-exchange failures correlated.

ben: Quick metrics: 5xx peaked at ~12% at 12:03 UTC, p95 ~1.2s. Error breakdown: ~65% upstream 5xx (token-exchange + observability-ingest), 20% gateway timeouts, rest internal. Retries causing queueing on frontend.

carla: Our observability vendor sent an incident note ~12:00 UTC: API rate-limits triggered -> 429/503 from their ingest API. Also their status page shows increased error rates. Token-exchange (3rdparty oauth) is returning intermittent 504s in eu-central. Both line up.

dinesh: Proposed mitigations (short):
1) Apply route-bypass for eu-central non-regional traffic to eu-west-1 (reduce load)
2) Enable auth token-cache fallback for 300s to avoid synchronous token exchange on hot paths
3) Scale dedicated cross-region burst for ded-eu-c-* to allow routing to eu-west-1 GPUs
4) Throttle aggressive client retries at API gateway (reduce amplification)

Commands I'll run now:
```bash
# update routing policy (example)
redwoodctl routes update --region eu-central-1 --fallback-region eu-west-1 --match "!regional=true"
# enable short auth cache
redwoodctl config set auth.token_cache_ttl 300 --apply-immediate
# reduce client retries at gateway
redwoodctl gateway config set retry.max_attempts 1
```

pager-oncall: Acknowledged. Running routing update + auth cache change. Will post status when complete.

(2m later) pager-oncall: routing update applied, traffic shifting to eu-west-1 for non-regional customers. Auth cache toggled to 300s. Observing initial drop in gateway queue length.

ben: After reroute, 5xx dropped to ~6% and p95 down to ~700ms. Observability ingestion errors still present (vendor-side) — logs delayed by ~90s.

support: Any confirmed customer-impact? Early signals: a few enterprise customers reported higher latency for tokenized endpoints, support tickets created. No broad data-plane downtime but degraded error rates for some tenants. Suggest preparing an advisory.

sre-lead: Agreed. Draft short status page message: "We are experiencing elevated errors and latency in eu-central-1 due to an upstream provider incident affecting auth and logs ingestion. We have applied routing and caching mitigations; traffic migrating to eu-west-1. Some customers may see degraded performance. Engineers are monitoring." Can someone post?

statusbot: Draft status page update created: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2026-042 - please review.

carla: Vendor updated: they are scaling their ingress but expect 30-60m for full recovery. We'll keep routing fallback for now and revisit in 30m.

dinesh: Action items assigned:
- @carla: coordinate with vendor + collect vendor timelines.
- @ben: monitor metrics & rollback routing when safe.
- @support: notify impacted customers with advisory.
- @alice/@pager-oncall: stay on pager for next 45m; escalate to SRE rotation if persists.

sre-lead: We'll run a short post-incident blameless review if this crosses 1hr. Otherwise capture runbook gaps (token cache default too low, routing symmetry).

alice: Ack. I'll keep live notes and update channel if anything changes. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
